verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Anrok tracking exposure (a world exposure map and early alerts before you owe), handling registration and filing going forward, and voiding or negating transactions. None of it documents voluntary disclosure agreements, back-filing, or any remediation path for past-due liability in jurisdictions where collection was missed. Those forward-looking registration and filing features are adjacent, not this capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, past-due exposure has a remediation path — voluntary disclosure agreements or back-filing support to clean up jurisdictions where I should have been collecting
